RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
1. Term. The lease begins on March 1, 2026 and ends on February 28, 2027.
2. Rent. Tenant shall pay $1,850 per month, due on the first day of each month. Late payment incurs a $75 fee.
3. Security Deposit. A deposit of $1,850 is held by the Landlord and returned within 30 days after move-out.
4. Animals. No dogs, cats, or other animals may be kept on the premises without prior written consent of the Landlord. An approved animal requires an additional deposit of $500.
5. Maintenance. Tenant shall keep the unit clean and report any water leaks within 48 hours.
6. Noise. Quiet hours are from 10 PM to 7 AM.
